name: plateway.account.get
description: Read the account holder, saved addresses with their delivery zones, saved cards (masked) and the App's current time and time zone. No side effects.

name: plateway.restaurants.search
description: Find restaurants that deliver to one of the account's addresses, optionally by text (restaurant or dish name, cuisine) and cuisine. Returns only restaurants serving that address's zone, each with its status at the App's current time (open, closed or paused), the delivery estimate in minutes (preparation plus travel to that zone), the delivery fee and the aggregate rating. No side effects.

name: plateway.restaurants.get
description: Read one restaurant: weekly hours, status, pause reason, delivery fee, preparation time, served zones with travel times, aggregate rating and its menu with prices, availability and the restaurant's declared allergens per dish. Declarations are shown as declared and not verified; empty lists mean none declared, not allergen-free. No side effects.

name: plateway.menu_items.get
description: Read one dish: description of its main ingredients, price, availability, declared allergens and its option groups (required or optional, minimum and maximum selections) with each option's price change and declared allergens. No side effects.

name: plateway.cart.get
description: Read the cart: its restaurant and lines with options, quantity, label and prices read from the current menu, plus each line's availability and the subtotal. No side effects.

name: plateway.cart.add_item
description: Add a dish to the cart with its option IDs, a quantity of 1 to 10 and an optional label of up to 40 characters shown on the receipt (never sent to the restaurant; it changes no dish). The 40-character limit counts Unicode code points; the schema's maxLength of 80 counts UTF-16 units so that 40 characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane fit, and a longer label is refused by the App with invalid_arguments. The cart holds one restaurant's dishes.

name: plateway.cart.update_item
description: Change a cart line's quantity, options or label. The label limit is 40 Unicode code points; the schema's maxLength of 80 counts UTF-16 units, and a longer label is refused by the App with invalid_arguments.

name: plateway.cart.remove_item
description: Remove a line from the cart.

name: plateway.checkout.preview
description: Preview the all-in total of the cart for an address, a card, as soon as possible or a scheduled delivery time, and a tip in cents: lines, delivery fee, 12% service fee, $2.49 small-order fee below a $12.00 subtotal, 8% tax per line, tip, total, the estimate or scheduled time and the release time. A scheduled time must be on a 15-minute boundary, 45 minutes through 7 days ahead, with its release time (delivery time minus the estimate) after now and inside the restaurant's weekly hours; a pause does not block scheduling. Runs the same checks as orders.place (except the card decline, which only an attempted charge reveals) and returns a token for orders.place. Stores nothing.

name: plateway.orders.list
description: List the account's orders, newest first, optionally by status, restaurant and a placed-at date range (inclusive). Statuses reflect the App's current time. No side effects.

name: plateway.orders.get
description: Read one order: lines with options and labels (removed lines are marked, not deleted), timeline, estimate, the itemized receipt as booked (fees, tax, tip, total and the charge), refunds, cancellation and rating, as of the App's current time. No side effects.

name: plateway.orders.place
description: Place the cart as an order with the token from checkout.preview, restating its address, card, delivery time and tip. Charges the card once for the previewed total; a declining or expired card fails with payment_failed and creates no order. A token whose business changes no longer match current state returns stale_preview.

name: plateway.orders.cancel.preview
description: Preview cancelling an order at its current stage: free while scheduled or submitted (full refund); while preparing only the delivery fee and tip are refunded and the rest is kept; picked_up, delivered and cancelled orders cannot be cancelled (invalid_state). Returns the charge, prior refunds, the refund, the amount kept, the refund card and a token for orders.cancel.confirm. Stores nothing.

name: plateway.orders.cancel.confirm
description: Cancel an order with the token from orders.cancel.preview. The status change, the refund to the original card and the notice commit together; a token whose stage or amounts no longer match returns stale_preview.

name: plateway.orders.report_issue
description: Report delivered lines as missing or wrong within 48 hours of delivery, once per line. Every named line is checked before any refund; each reported line is refunded its subtotal plus tax to the original card, automatically and in full.

name: plateway.orders.rate
description: Rate a delivered order once within 30 days of delivery: 1 to 5 stars with optional text of up to 500 characters (Unicode code points). The restaurant's aggregate rating is not recomputed.
